description: Approved dependency SPDX licenses. Every term in an AND branch must be approved; an expression passes when at least one OR branch passes. Nonstandard expressions are ratcheted separately. LGPL-3.0-only is listed because eslint-plugin-sonarjs is the cognitive-complexity survey engine. CC-BY-SA-4.0 is listed for cspell's bundled misspellings dictionary: it is a share-alike licence on a data file, and it is approved here only because that file is a development dependency that no shipped artifact contains or adapts. A CC-BY-SA dependency that reached a released binary would need a fresh decision, not this one.

@cspell/dict-en-common-misspellings@2.2..reason: Package metadata uses the non-SPDX spelling 'CC BY-SA 4.0'.

@freenetorg/freenet-stdlib@0.3.0.reason: Package metadata uses the non-SPDX shorthand MIT+APACHE-2.0.

khroma@2.1.0.reason: The package tarball ships an MIT license file but omits the lockfile license field.
